Mr. Leonard is renting a car for one day. The table below shows the total amount he will be charged for the car based on the number of miles he drives.

Car Rental

| Number of Miles, m | Total Amount Charged, c |
|--------------------|------------------------|
| 5                  | $30.50                 |
| 10                 | $31.00                 |
| 15                 | $31.50                 |
| 20                 | $32.00                 |

Which equation best represents c, the number of dollars Mr. Leonard should be charged for driving m miles?
